notes.title: 1.0.2 Evac Zone Update
notes.notes:
Added a huge lift where players start and finish missions, players now start missions at a same location
Added screens where players can see how many players are alive
Added health station where players can heal themselves
Added more default face symbols
Fixed some bugs regarding to map generation

notes.title: Update for 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Players can now type words on their faces, any words
Changed layout of the lobby
Added a personal terminal, players can now get ready and customize your character on it
Reduced the damage of bad guys
New players now get 1000 points at start
More will be added to the personal terminal later
